meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会把代码库映射成按功能分组的流程图，找出多个功能里重复的代码逻辑，提出一套统一改造方案，并给出可直接交给 /make-plan 的后续计划。它不写实现代码，只产出分析和规划文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求“找到理想路径”、统一重复的系统，或在重构前审计架构时触发。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 分析这个代码库，找出重复逻辑。
say.note: 它会将代码映射成功能流程图并输出重复报告。

say.text: 重构前，用 pathfinder 审计架构里的重复点。
say.note: 它会产出统一方案和 /make-plan 交接提示。

say.text: 帮我统一两个系统的重复实现，走 pathfinder。
say.note: 它会给出针对每个统一系统的改造计划。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated logic, proposes a unified architecture, and outputs /make-plan prompts. It does not implement code—only produces analysis and planning docs.
howto.when_en: Trigger when asked to 'find the ideal path,' unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Run pathfinder on this repo to find duplicated logic.
say_en.note: It produces feature flowcharts and a duplication report.

say_en.text: Before the refactor, use pathfinder to audit duplicates in the architecture.
say_en.note: It will return a unified proposal and /make-plan handoffs.

say_en.text: Unify the duplicated implementations in these two systems via pathfinder.
